i.norm: Verifies that a string containing non-alpha characters (pipes, digits, punctuation) mixed with alphabetic characters is cleaned and NYSIIS-encoded correctly in strict mode (max 6 characters). The default Nysiis constructor enables strict mode. Input: "|5tl0=0cuh:63pEY" After cleaning (letters only, uppercased): "TLCUHPEY" Expected NYSIIS code (strict, max 6 chars): "TLCAPY"
Default constructor sets strict mode (max 6-char output)
Non-alphabetic characters are stripped by SoundexUtils.clean before encoding
